content.short: Indonesia's largest crypto exchange, operating since 2014 and supervised by OJK.
content.description: Indodax was the first crypto exchange in Indonesia and remains the largest, with more than 10 million registered members and over 500 listed assets. It is licensed and supervised by the Financial Services Authority (OJK), offers an OTC desk and an education academy, and has offices in Jakarta and Bali. Users trade in rupiah through its web platform and mobile apps.
content.meta: Trade 500+ crypto assets in rupiah on Indodax, Indonesia's first and largest exchange, licensed by OJK since 2014.
